one_line: Tech stocks plunge amid data center concerns as Microsoft offers buyouts, OpenAI changes policies, and new models launch.

themes.title: Market and infrastructure pressures grow
themes.text: Asian tech stocks plummeted amid concerns that US Democrats may delay data centers, while OpenAI changed its NDA policies and Microsoft offered voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees as AI spending increases. Meanwhile, activists breached a Microsoft data center construction site in Amsterdam as European protests against large-scale data center projects began.

stories.headline: Asian tech stocks plunge amid fears US Democrats may delay data centers
OpenAI steps back from NDAs and promises full power costs for data centers
Activists breach Microsoft data centre site in Amsterdam as protests spread across Europe
Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees as AI spending grows

themes.title: New models and enterprise tools launch
themes.text: Google DeepMind released the Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash video model, and Mistral AI launched its Studio Le Chonk enterprise platform. Nvidia released four open-weight Cosmos 3 Nano checkpoints for simulation, and Dropbox announced a $350 million acquisition of Tigris Data.

stories.headline: Google DeepMind launches Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash video model with 15-second clips
Mistral launches Studio Le Chonk platform for enterprise AI deployment
Nvidia adds four open-weight Cosmos 3 Nano checkpoints for interactive simulation
Dropbox to acquire AI storage startup Tigris Data for $350 million

themes.title: Hardware efficiency and research advances
themes.text: Nvidia detailed how full-stack codesign and its Vera CPU increase agentic throughput and power efficiency. Researchers also introduced the VLA-Tug probe for vision-language-action failure detection and a meta-access framework for LLM chat interfaces.

stories.headline: Nvidia uses full‑stack codesign to boost AI memory efficiency
Nvidia vera cpu offers higher agent throughput and better power efficiency
VLA‑Tug probe improves early failure detection in vision‑language‑action models
Researchers propose meta‑access framework to extend LLM chat interfaces
